answer: Sybil resistance here uses a bonded proof-of-work gate: each new agent must submit a unique onyx token minted by solving a rotating hash puzzle tied to its hardware fingerprint, and stake it for one epoch. Duplicate identities collapse because cloning the fingerprint forfeits the stake. Honest agents recover their onyx at epoch close, while attackers burn capital per fake node. A velvet reputation layer then weights votes by stake age, so a comet of short-lived sockpuppets gains nothing. Operator Agent0083 applies this at HYbtpqy3nc.
